claim_or_parameter: An operating utility-scale PV facility can experience simultaneous array-area, electrical-room, transformer/control and outage consequences during a wildfire.
permitted_use: Justify multi-subsystem scope and field-data collection.
prohibited_inference: Curve ordinate, whole-site loss ratio, or replacement cost
update_trigger: engineering report or claims file for the event

claim_or_parameter: Wildfire-affected PV modules may show hot spots and EL degradation patterns that performance or I-V checks alone do not resolve.
permitted_use: Require EL/IR plus electrical testing and continued monitoring in a field protocol.
prohibited_inference: Population fragility, local-dose threshold, or economic DR
update_trigger: full text and event-level inspection data

claim_or_parameter: The accessible wildfire-PV field-study abstract does not publish the local fire exposure, full affected/unaffected denominator, BOM, replacement decision, or repair cost required for curve calibration.
prohibited_inference: Treat observed degradation as a numerical fragility row

claim_or_parameter: Broad PV insurance category 'fire' is material but cannot be assumed to mean exogenous wildfire; the public chart does not expose asset-years, component states, local dose, or same-unit costs.
permitted_use: Support research priority and insurer-data request design.
prohibited_inference: Wildfire frequency, severity distribution, or fragility
update_trigger: de-identified claim microdata with peril taxonomy and exposure denominator

claim_or_parameter: Wildland-fire incident heat transfer varies materially by fuel and fire regime; radiant and convective terms and their durations cannot be represented by one universal scalar.
locator: field measurements across surface, shrub and crown settings
permitted_use: Require pathway-specific flux/contact/time state and uncertainty.

claim_or_parameter: A defensible local attack transfer requires at least fuel state, flame geometry, distance/view factor, wind/slope, component position and duration; FSim FIL/FLP alone does not provide these fields.
locator: product attributes compared with local heat-flux studies
permitted_use: Define regional-screening and site-loss modes separately.

claim_or_parameter: Fire/heat-damaged controls and electrical equipment need category-specific inspect/evaluate/replace rules; these post-event rules do not establish pre-event failure probabilities.
permitted_use: Translate observed damage state into governed disposition with OEM/qualified evaluation.

claim_or_parameter: FM ground-mounted-solar wildland-fire recommendations define auditable control fields but publish no efficacy distribution suitable for a damage multiplier.
permitted_use: Capture compliance, geometry, vegetation, access and maintenance as selectors or study covariates.

claim_or_parameter: ASTM E108 and IEC 61730 qualifications are scope-limited safety/test selectors and are not wildfire survival curves for a ground-mounted utility PV population.
locator: published standards scope and IEA test mapping
permitted_use: Record exact qualification/test status in BOM metadata.

claim_or_parameter: Glass layup, pre-damage, inclination, exposure magnitude and exposure duration change PV specimen response; laboratory endpoints are therefore BOM- and protocol-specific.
permitted_use: Define module BOM/protocol applicability and candidate thermal states.
prohibited_inference: Universal utility-module fragility or economic DR
update_trigger: representative full-size population tests with replacement endpoints

claim_or_parameter: The audited Hazard consumer currently creates numerical loss by assigning class midpoints including an open-ended FIL6 representative, converting to kW/m, applying unsupported capex-weighted subsystem logistics, setting site p_hit to one, and applying the result to TIV.
permitted_use: Allow only explicitly nonreportable legacy/proxy comparison while migration occurs.
prohibited_inference: Canonical Damage Modeling output or reportable EAL/PML
update_trigger: Hazard removes or isolates proxy path and consumes a released cell

claim_or_parameter: FSim burn probability and conditional flame-length probabilities can support regional hazard screening, but without a site/local attack bridge they cannot support wildfire-solar M3 physical loss.
locator: source attributes and docs r2 search decision
permitted_use: Publish hazard-only regional screening with no loss output.
prohibited_inference: Numerical conditional DR from FSim alone
update_trigger: qualified site coupling and failure-unit response

claim_or_parameter: The first defensible site-loss model should accept measured or qualified model outputs for local component attack rather than treating FSim fireline intensity as the vulnerability axis.
permitted_use: Design local heat/contact/duration/ember inputs with provenance and uncertainty.
prohibited_inference: Claim that a numerical response is already calibrated

claim_or_parameter: A future runtime release may be modular by failure unit and zone; it must not silently become one aggregate whole-plant FIL-to-DR curve.
permitted_use: Sum same-unit direct losses across qualified failure units and zones, then allocate support costs once.
prohibited_inference: Use of pooled subsystem weights as fragility

claim_or_parameter: A module-only qualified pathway cannot be presented as whole-site wildfire loss unless uncovered material failure units are explicitly withheld or bounded under an approved coverage policy.
locator: coverage standard and multi-subsystem field event
permitted_use: Permit partial research models only with explicit coverage status and no whole-site claim.
prohibited_inference: Implicit zero damage for unmodelled electrical, controls, MV, mounting or civil units
update_trigger: coverage-policy approval and additional calibrated pathways

claim_or_parameter: A calibration-ready field program needs event footprint and local attack reconstruction, pre-event BOM/inventory, affected and unaffected units, EL/IR/I-V/visual disposition, repair/replacement work orders, and same-unit value denominators.
locator: combined diagnostic, remote-sensing and governance protocol
permitted_use: Use as minimum data-request schema and pilot-study protocol.
prohibited_inference: A claim that existing sources already meet the schema

claim_or_parameter: The 2026-07-10 deep review found no reviewed public dataset that closes the complete chain from FSim or local wildfire exposure through utility-PV component disposition to same-unit replacement cost.
locator: docs r2 bounded-search log and promotion matrix
permitted_use: Keep model v0.1 and target the named acquisition gates.
prohibited_inference: Universal claim that no evidence exists outside the review scope
update_trigger: new public/partner dataset or repeat evidence review

claim_or_parameter: Docs r2 changes evidence, consumer instructions and promotion criteria only; there are still zero runtime curves and all numerical loss metrics remain withheld.
permitted_use: Advance documentation revision without changing semantic model version.
prohibited_inference: Use of model v1.0 label or numeric DR
